Summary.en: Forces a date field to accept only dates within the configured minimum distance in the past (or, reversed, in the future).
Summary.de: Erzwingt, dass ein Datumsfeld nur Daten im konfigurierten Mindestabstand in der Vergangenheit akzeptiert (oder umgekehrt in der Zukunft).
Summary.it: Impedisce a un campo data di accettare date al di fuori della distanza minima configurata nel passato (o, se invertito, nel futuro).

Parameter.Minimum: The amount of years/months/weeks (per the Unit parameter) in the past that the entered date must be at least in order to be valid.
Parameter.MsgHigher: The error message shown when the entered date is not far enough in the past (or, with Reverse, too far). [%ERROR_DATE%] is replaced with the minimum valid date.
Parameter.Delimiter: The string separating the day, month and year. Defaults to '.'.
Parameter.Reverse: Whether to invert the logic and permit dates up to a certain future limit instead of a past minimum (defaults to false).
Parameter.Unit: The unit of the Minimum amount: d, w, m or y (defaults to 'y').

Minimum.default: The amount of years/months/weeks (per the Unit parameter) in the past that the entered date must be at least in order to be valid.

MsgHigher.default: The error message shown when the entered date is not far enough in the past (or, with Reverse, too far). [%ERROR_DATE%] is replaced with the minimum valid date.
